purpose: Deterministic re-derivation of every transcribed NFL value against the official source. No network access; no inference.

team_scoring_tables.reason: Both pages render 4 header-less columns. Columns 1-2 reconcile exactly with rushing TD and passing TD that appear on the offense passing/rushing pages (checked for all 32 clubs), but NO arithmetic identity held for columns 3-4 (e.g. SF 12+17=29 but col3=31; TB 11+6=17 vs 19; ATL 9+11=20 vs 21; DEN 9+11=20 vs 21). Defensive identity also fails (CIN 1+1+0=2 but published total column = 0). Column meaning cannot be established from the source, so these values are NOT published or used. Flagged for Review FL-04.

checks.name: Every game row references two distinct, real NFL clubs
No club plays more than once in any week
Points-for recomputed from the official game log equals official standings PF for all 32 clubs
Points-against recomputed from the official game log equals official standings PA for all 32 clubs
League-wide points scored equals league-wide points allowed
W-L-T recomputed from the game log equals official standings W-L-T for all 32 clubs
Standings PCT equals (W + T/2)/(W+L+T) for all 32 clubs
Standings net points equals PF - PA for all 32 clubs
games played in standings equals game-log appearances
Published streak equals the club's trailing result string in the chronological game log (through week 9)
Team-stat table covers exactly the 32 NFL clubs
League-total offense passing yards equals league-total defense passing yards allowed (zero-sum conservation)
League-total offense rushing yards equals league-total defense rushing yards allowed (zero-sum conservation)
League-total offense sacks equals league-total defense sacks allowed (zero-sum conservation)
League-total offense passing touchdowns equals league-total defense passing touchdowns allowed (zero-sum conservation)
League-total offense rushing touchdowns equals league-total defense rushing touchdowns allowed (zero-sum conservation)
League-total offense interceptions equals league-total defense interceptions allowed (zero-sum conservation)
League-total offense passing first downs equals league-total defense passing first downs allowed (zero-sum conservation)
League-total offense rushing first downs equals league-total defense rushing first downs allowed (zero-sum conservation)
Offense passing yards + rushing yards equals the 'TOTAL OFFENSIVE YARDS' printed on the club page (KC cross-check)

checks.name: Team yards-per-attempt equals YDS/ATT rounded half-up to 1dp, for all 32 clubs
checks.detail: mismatches=[{'team': 'KC', 'att': 263, 'yds': 2037, 'published': 7.8, 'computed': 7.7}, {'team': 'JAX', 'att': 227, 'yds': 1940, 'published': 8.6, 'computed': 8.5}, {'team': 'SEA', 'att': 288, 'yds': 2089, 'published': 7.2, 'computed': 7.3}, {'team': 'PIT', 'att': 290, 'yds': 1871, 'published': 6.4, 'computed': 6.5}]; 28/32 agree. Tested and rejected alternative denominators: (YDS+SACK_YDS)/(ATT+SACKS) fails 22/32, YDS/(ATT+SACKS) fails 32/32. Hence a source-value irregularity (FL-07), not a transcription error.
